title: Epic Daze Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Welcome to the Bungalows at Seagrove! This charming community is located in Seagrove just a short walk to the beach with 2 shared pools and a hot tub, beautiful lush landscaping and neighborhood walkways.
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - ACCESS TO THE PUBLIC WIDE BEACH (OR PRIVATE FOR MAIN TOWNS) WITH NO RESTRICTIONS. - Short walk to the beach and community pool with hot tub - Golf cart charging stations - 2 adult sized beach cruisers included - Beach wagon, 2 beach chairs, umbrella and toys at the property for guest enjoyment. - Private grill (propane) - Balcony overlooking pool - Fully stocked kitchen - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: **Optional Cancellation Protection**- Allows cancellation for ANY reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies paid returned ($100 fee applies at booking). “Epic Daze” is a 2 bedroom/ 2.5 bath cottage home with open living and dining spaces, clean and comfortable furnishings, tasteful coastal decor, private bed and bathroom suites with added storage, a balcony overlooking the community and so much more. The updated kitchen offers stainless steel appliances, tiled flooring, counter height bar seating for 3 and dining space for 5 more with scenic lake views. The kitchen opens to the living room with plenty of seating for the whole family, a flat screen SMART TV, Blu-ray DVD and high-speed internet. A half bath off the living room with a stackable washer/dryer completes the main level. Upstairs, featuring luxury wood-look plank flooring throughout, you will enjoy the 2 bedrooms, each with private baths. The KING master bedroom has balcony access along with a private bath (shower only) and a flat screen TV. The guest bedroom offers a QUEEN bed with additional TWIN trundle daybed (sleeps 2) sleeping. This bedroom also has balcony access and a private bath (tub/shower combo). The upstairs balcony offers views of the community, pool and hot tub, and lush beach landscaping. Beach access, at the end of the road, is made easy with the supplied beach cart. A convenience store is located at the beach access entrance for any last-minute beach needs. ACCOMMODATIONS:(Sleeps 6): Both bedrooms are on the 2nd floor Bedroom 1: King bed with private bath (shower only), flat screen TV, and balcony access overlooking the pool. Bedroom 2: Queen bed with additional daybed with trundle and private bath (shower/tub combo), balcony access overlooking the pool. Welcome to the Bungalows at Seagrove! This charming community is located in Seagrove just steps to the pool and a short walk (5 min max) to the beach. 2 shared pools and a hot tub, beautiful, lush landscaping and neighborhood walkways. This cottage comes with 2 bikes included with your rental and an electric grill for your convenience. Within walking/biking distance, there are numerous award-winning restaurants like Cafe 30-A, Perfect Pig, Brozzini’s Pizza, Dough Sea Dough Donuts and Angelina’s. Or if you prefer to cook in, Goatfeathers Market is also walking distance for fresh seafood. Come enjoy the white sand beaches and all that “Epic Daze” and 30-A have to offer! *Sorry, no pets. *Certificate #212266 TDT#21844 FREE WIFI

Health And Safety: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF

all: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
